title: ActionSendText
description:
Sends a text message to any phone number.

Optionally, the message can be scheduled after a predefined delay, or sent via a different phone than the one that received the message.

route_id.description: ID of the route to send the message from. If not specified, uses the default route.

label_names.description: Array of label names to apply to the sent message.

schedule.description: Schedule to send the message at a later time.

to_number.description: Phone number to send the message to.
